caption: The drawing depicts a wooden highboy chest of drawers standing on four cabriole legs with claw-and-ball feet. The highboy consists of two main sections: the upper section has four rows of drawers, with the topmost row divided into two smaller drawers and the remaining ones being full-width drawers, each with two ornate brass handles and a decorative brass keyhole plate. The lower section has three smaller drawers arranged in a row above a single, wider drawer, all also with brass handles and keyhole plates. The wood is rendered in shades of brown with visible grain patterns, and the brass handles are colored in muted gold. The front edge of the lower section features a scalloped decorative skirt, while the corners and legs have carved details. The background is plain and light beige.
title: Highboy
